title: Unsupported binary operators pass checking
notes: Operators outside the supported Moss surface must produce a Moss diagnostic rather than leak to Fast Debug or Rust; this is not a request for bitwise operators.

title: Vector[Trait]() passes frontend check but fails native compilation
notes: Moss v0.1 deliberately has no runtime trait objects or dynamic dispatch, so a runtime collection of abstract trait instances is illegal and must be diagnosed in the frontend.

title: Failure/precondition mechanism for user code is undocumented
notes: Clarify what v0.1 promises for ordinary assertions and preconditions. Broader recoverable error propagation is tracked separately and deferred to Phase 21.

title: Untyped parameter field access monomorphizes function to first caller type
notes: Decide whether field-based static duck typing participates in per-call-site specialization in the same way as method-based structural use before implementation work begins.

title: Untyped collection indexing fails checking with container error
notes: Decide whether indexing an untyped parameter establishes an Indexable/container constraint and specializes per concrete collection type before implementing a repair.

title: Parenthesized subexpression lowers to redundant Rust parentheses
notes: A legal parenthesized Moss expression must retain its expression meaning through native lowering without producing an invalid or misleading backend artifact.

title: Nested mutating calls on the same receiver lower to a Rust double borrow
notes: Accepted nested mutation must preserve Moss ownership and receiver semantics through expression lowering rather than leaking a Rust borrow failure.

title: Reassigning an initialized mutable local across all conditional branches triggers rustc unused-assignments
notes: The accepted Moss control-flow construct must lower without backend warning-as-error failure caused by an implementation artifact.

title: Binary string concatenation between owned String and literal fails rustc
notes: String concatenation is already a supported Moss operation; its ownership and result semantics must survive native lowering.

title: Chained field access on indexed vector in method omits usize cast in backend
notes: A legal indexed field access must retain Moss index semantics and generate a valid native expression.

title: assertEqual with brace in string literal leaks unescaped brace into Rust format string
notes: Test assertion values are Moss strings; their contents must not be reinterpreted as native formatting syntax during lowering.

title: Struct field named with a Rust reserved keyword fails native compilation
notes: Valid Moss field names must remain representable through backend name handling without exposing Rust keyword restrictions.

title: Boolean pipeline (filter |> any) fails native lowering with invalid return type
notes: The checked functional pipeline has a settled Boolean result and native lowering must preserve that result type.

title: for i in range accepted by checker but native lowering loses induction binding
notes: An accepted range loop must preserve its induction binding and loop result through native lowering; Fast Debug limitations are tracked separately where applicable.

title: Returning a unary-negated name fails type inference
notes: The legal unary-negation form must retain its inferred result type rather than failing during type/result inference.

title: No-value function ending in a collection push fails result inference
notes: A legal no-value function whose final statement mutates a collection must preserve its unit/no-value result semantics through inference.

title: Collection method on struct field during handler effect analysis triggers internal invariant error
notes: Effect and synchronization analysis must preserve the meaning of a legal collection operation on a struct field instead of aborting on an internal invariant.

title: Exported trait-annotated function crashes with internal synchronization invariant
notes: Exported legal structural-typing code must retain its inferred effects and synchronization facts across the checking boundary.

title: Compiler assertion abort on pipeline reduce with Map accumulator
notes: A legal reduce pipeline with a Map accumulator must retain its specialization and accumulator semantics through functional lowering.

title: Nested generic specialization fails in Rust lowering backend
notes: Nested concrete specialization is a compiler responsibility once Moss accepts the source; backend lowering must preserve the resolved types.

title: Unqualified sibling callable argument across modules fails native lowering
notes: A statically known callable reference must retain its resolved target across module boundaries and native lowering.

title: Fast Debug interpreter fails to resolve function identifier passed as callable argument
notes: Fast Debug must preserve the checked meaning of a statically known callable argument rather than rejecting a valid resolved function identifier.

title: Exported struct fields lower without pub modifier across modules
notes: Moving a valid exported struct behind a module boundary must not change field visibility or native accessibility.

title: Methods of exported types are omitted from compiled .mossi interface metadata
notes: The semantic module interface must preserve the exported methods of an exported type so downstream Moss code sees the same language surface.

title: for i in range fails type inference when enclosed in an explicit module
notes: Introducing an explicit module boundary must not change type inference for an otherwise-valid range loop.

title: Sibling method call within exported module type mis-mangles as module function
notes: A sibling method call on an exported type must retain its receiver and resolved method identity across module lowering.

title: Test binary compilation fails when test modules import internal modules omitted from main.moss
notes: Test compilation must preserve the project module graph rather than requiring test-reachable internal modules to be imported by main.moss.

title: Specialized imported generic function calling transitive module fails native lowering
notes: Cross-package specialization and transitive module calls must preserve their resolved semantics when lowered natively.

title: Transitive struct field types leak unimported Rust trait requirements across modules
notes: A module interface must carry Moss semantic type requirements without leaking backend-only Rust trait requirements to consumers.

title: Formatter rejects valid statements whose expression begins with an opening parenthesis
notes: Retain as a formatter/tooling issue unless later evidence establishes a semantic preservation defect.

title: effects reports a pure loop helper as divergent/unresolved yet it is accepted as a domain initializer
notes: The semantic query and accepted initializer behavior disagree; retain this as tooling classification pending closer semantic review.

title: No project-wide Fast Debug test discovery/orchestration
notes: This is a project test-discovery/orchestration gap, not a claim that Moss source semantics are wrong.

title: Multi-file project diagnostics misattribute error source file to root or first module
notes: Track source attribution quality separately from semantic correctness.

title: moss edit rename fails on module-qualified entities with EDIT_TARGET_AMBIGUOUS
notes: This is a semantic-edit tooling resolution defect; it is not forced into a semantic category.

title: Static callable parameters for ordinary functions
notes: Support statically-known callable parameters for patterns such as sort(items, comparator) and map_by(items, named_function), without escaping closures, runtime function objects, or dynamic dispatch.

title: No general explicit copy operation for nontrivial values
notes: Ownership-aware collection work needs a documented source operation meaning: give me a new owned value equivalent to x, especially for Strings, records, and Vector[Struct] values.

title: Core String manipulation surface
notes: Track the ordinary String operations realistic applications need, including length, character access, iteration, split, parse, and join; the exact API is intentionally undecided here.

title: Map deletion
notes: Map insertion, reads, and default lookup exist, but deletion is absent and workloads resorted to tombstones or alive flags.

title: Enums and tagged unions
notes: Translated workloads naturally wanted closed variants and token kinds instead of strings, integer tags, or records; syntax and representation are not designed in this task.

title: Static Self or covariant trait return
notes: Structural tree abstractions want a static-polymorphism mechanism equivalent to a trait method returning Self; this is not a request for runtime dynamic dispatch or recursion.

title: Recoverable error propagation
notes: Track ordinary recoverable error propagation or Result-like semantics for the existing later Error Propagation & Supervision phase. Do not design exception or Result semantics here.
